item.title: Elon Musk’s Boring Co. Names Dallas Development as a Finalist for Free Mile-Long Tunnel
item.description: Dallas Innovates, Every Day: Here's what's new + next in North Texas. The company will do the digging with its advanced tunnel boring machine, called Prufrock, which can install its own structural tunnel lining while it “porpoises” its way down into the earth and back up out the other end.… The post Elon Musk’s Boring Co.
